title: Knee Brace Coverage
extracted_text:
Example Health Plan
Knee Brace Coverage Policy KB001

Overview
This made up policy describes when a knee brace is covered.

Initial Criteria
1. The member must meet ALL of the following:
   a. A clinician has documented knee instability.
   b. The member has tried physical therapy for 6 weeks.
2. The member must meet ONE of the following:
   a. The brace is custom fitted.
   b. A prefabricated brace has failed.

Continuation Criteria
1. The member shows documented improvement.
